concerns.text: T103 specifies output schema 'config_id, scaling_method, test_type, error_rate, power, ci_lower, ci_upper' and claims it conforms to the AggregateMetrics contract, but that contract requires total_iterations, rejected_count, empirical_error_rate, confidence_interval_lower/upper, nominal_alpha, deviation and sets additionalProperties:false. As written the task cannot satisfy the contract it claims; either the task schema or the contract must be reconciled — silently shipping a non-conforming CSV is a constraint violation.

T102's simulation_results.csv schema (iteration_id, config_id, scaling_method, test_type, p_value, statistic, ground_truth, scaling_params, seed) omits required TestResult fields result_id, is_rejected, error_type and adds non-contract columns. The task presents this as the flattened TestResult store (per data-model.md Data Flow) but it does not conform; reconcile before implementation.

T105 fits a synthetic FIXED-effects model (deviation ~ C(config_id) + scaling_method) but must output MixedEffectModelOutput, whose required field random_effects_variance (minimum 0) is undefined for a fixed-effects-only model. The task must specify how this required field is populated (e.g., 0.0 with documented justification) or the output will violate the contract.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies and requirement coverage (FR-008) vs spec.md:FR-008
concerns.text: FR-008 mandates ingesting at least 10 public datasets from UCI and OpenML, but plan.md Scale/Scope names only two verified datasets (HAR, Shopper) and the tasks list marks FR-008 as covered by 'done' T024–T039/T051–T066 with no task establishing how the remaining datasets are selected, verified, or ingested to reach the FR-008 minimum. Claiming FR-008 coverage while the plan scopes two datasets is a silent requirement weakening.

FR-003 requires the Chi-squared test on binned data, and the preserved tasks T015–T023 do mention 'chi-squared with binning', but the TestResult contract and data-model.md removed chi_squared from the test_type enum. The task list's FR-002/FR-003 coverage claim is contradicted by the contract the results must conform to; either restore chi_squared to the contract or document the narrowing in the spec — it cannot be silently dropped at the contract layer.

The 'Preserved completed work (verified; do not redo)' section marks T001–T014, T015–T023, T030, T040–T044 as unchecked '- [ ]' while the header says they are verified and must not be redone. This ambiguity about which foundational work (generator, scaling, tests, plots) actually exists repeats the exact failure mode that triggered this re-plan; make the status unambiguous.

SC-006 requires measuring consistency between synthetic and real-world results, but T109 only documents the comparison narratively in summary_report.md with no verification step defining what 'consistency' means or how it is checked. The acceptance criterion has no surviving pass/fail check in any task's verification.
